Pathfinder

Skid-steer ground rover
Pass

RobotForge's own demo robot — an original design, not a copy of anything: a four-wheel skid-steer rover for warehouse aisle patrol, described in one plain paragraph and built entirely by the forge. Entry #004 is ours.

Gate runs

Measured against simulator ground truth at the locked thresholds: pass ≤ 5% / 5°, fail over 10% / 10°. The gate tests the spec's simulated twin, not a physical robot.

Take it apart

Every spec becomes a kit of simple, 3D-printable parts (robotforge cad). This viewer lays the kit out the way the kit's own assembly file does, straight from the spec's numbers. Click any part.

Loading examples/pathfinder.json…

Reproduce it

Run these from a clone of the repository.

robotforge validate examples/pathfinder.json
robotforge urdf examples/pathfinder.json --out build/pathfinder.urdf
robotforge cad examples/pathfinder.json
robotforge run-gate examples/pathfinder.json
